channel.title: Acme: W3C Changes
channel.description: Reports on substantive changes in W3C GitHub repositories.

item.title: SHACL Core Warns About Validation-Report Privacy
item.description:
SHACL Core adds a warning that validation reports can reveal graph content through values and result messages when users may run validation without permission to inspect the underlying graph. Implementations should consider report access alongside data access.

Changes: data-shapes 807efba7be.

item.title: Trusted Types Unwraps Values Outside Protected Sinks
item.description:
The Trusted Types draft clarifies that setting an attribute that is not a Trusted Types sink returns the underlying data of a Trusted Type value. This avoids applying sink-specific handling to ordinary attributes.

Changes: trusted-types a280ec2245.

item.title: Credential Management Refines Reauthentication and Creation
item.description:
Credential Management examples now await reauthentication before form submission. The draft also links credential creation to AbortSignal handling and compares credential-type identifiers as strings, improving algorithmic consistency.

Changes: webappsec-credential-management d322c4f249; webappsec-credential-management 3d292a9892; webappsec-credential-management ead9f78b70.

item.title: SOSA/SSN Clarifies System and Domain Modeling
item.description:
SOSA/SSN guidance aligns system-instance examples with the recommended system-type pattern, recommends reusing suitable catalogue properties before inventing new ones, and says subclassing FeatureOfInterest is permissible when intended.

Changes: sdw-sosa-ssn ffd7892901; sdw-sosa-ssn b605530fe7; sdw-sosa-ssn e363e0b16f.

item.title: Push API Revises Event Data and Subscription Algorithms
item.description:
Push API draft changes handle null PushEvent data, skip non-map declarative actions, remove vibration from declarative notifications, and clarify asynchronous subscription promise settlement and scope matching. These related commits sharpen push-delivery and subscription behavior.

Changes: push-api 6947efdf43; push-api a236755239; push-api 883db62269; push-api 92f9b3ccb6; push-api 72ad7cffd4; push-api 692ab067d3; push-api 9c5bfbe6b8.

item.title: Recognized Entities Draft Revises Anchors and Threat Responses
item.description:
The Recognized Entities draft replaces trust-anchor terminology with recognition anchors, clarifies holder versus subject, makes validator media-type branches exclusive, and expands threat responses including false evidence and residual risk. It also generalizes integrity hashes for referenced resources.

Changes: vc-recognized-entities d62c833fa5; vc-recognized-entities 89d22f9b8e; vc-recognized-entities c39b78fac4; vc-recognized-entities 3aaba1cbe7; vc-recognized-entities 8d114e19bf; vc-recognized-entities 84fca6a0ce; vc-recognized-entities d15d9a818f.

item.title: SPARQL Drafts Add Optional Media-Type Version Parameter
item.description:
The SPARQL Query and Update drafts add an optional version parameter to their media types, with acceptable values defined by version labels. The paired changes give clients and servers a way to identify the version of a SPARQL representation.

Changes: sparql-update 8669330906; sparql-query f8b4bcac9a.

item.title: DID Resolution Narrows URL Equivalence
item.description:
DID Resolution now limits percent-encoding equivalence in DID URL query normalization to unreserved characters. The change avoids treating reserved characters as interchangeable when they may alter meaning.

Changes: did-resolution 7b9713fb3a.

item.title: DID Vocabulary Adds Resolution Error Terms
item.description:
The DID vocabulary adds error conditions from DID Resolution, including a ResolutionError term linked to the resolution specification. It aligns machine-readable identity terms with the developing resolution error model.

Changes: did 5546baa400.

item.title: DID Extensions Registry Adds Methods and Error Rules
item.description:
The DID Extensions registry adds methods including did:ndc, did:vh and did:vector, publishes a resolution registry, and requires each registered error type to provide its defining specification's URL. Registration records identifiers; it does not imply W3C endorsement of a method.

Changes: did-extensions ba7a7c0780; did-extensions 4499ad71bb; did-extensions bd7b79b07d; did-extensions 03dc4d33ec; did-extensions 30dd0e5622.

item.title: DID Working Group Charter Published
item.description:
The DID Working Group repository carries a newly published charter. The charter defines the group's current remit; publication does not imply every DID deliverable or method has been standardized.

Changes: did-wg-charter d8e1b7a4df.

item.title: Media Session Defines a Task Source
item.description:
The Media Session specification introduces a media session task source for queued tasks. It makes the scheduling model for media-session operations more explicit to implementers.

Changes: mediasession 420075a901.

item.title: CSS Gaps Draft Refines Grid-Lanes Decorations
item.description:
CSS Gaps 1 defines when gap rules remain visible after grid-lanes alignment and adds segment endpoints around spanning items. The draft limits these decorations to the grid axis rather than the stacking axis.

Changes: csswg-drafts c94587b0bd; csswg-drafts 760f28edc5.

item.title: Data Integrity Uses Parsed Proof Indexes
item.description:
The Verifiable Credential Data Integrity draft reads mandatory indexes from parsed proof data when constructing its mandatory statements. The change aligns processing with the proof representation used by the algorithm.

Changes: vc-data-integrity 99896981e8.

item.title: Event Timing Explains How to Derive INP
item.description:
The Event Timing explainer adds a worked account of deriving Interaction to Next Paint from event entries. It helps readers connect raw performance entries with the page-responsiveness metric without changing the metric's definition.

Changes: event-timing a2f18d730f.

item.title: Draft Sustainability Charter Adds Impact Ratings
item.description:
A draft W3C charter adds Web Sustainability Guidelines Impact Ratings and proposes incorporating SCI for Web metrics into those ratings. The proposed deliverable is not yet a published Recommendation or completed rating system.

Changes: charter-drafts dd57f32113.

item.title: IFT Encoder Enables All-Pairs Segment Merging
item.description:
The Incremental Font Transfer encoder implements an all-pairs candidate-merging strategy with cost and invalidation handling and enables it by default, while retaining a fallback for minimum group sizes. A separate fix corrects patch-merge candidate selection. These are encoder implementation changes.

Changes: ift-encoder 0d3af12eb5; ift-encoder b10612565a; ift-encoder fdc7ce44d2; ift-encoder c4d4ed57da; ift-encoder fa0fbdc6b2; ift-encoder 4153e4e73a; ift-encoder c0ed51613b.

item.title: CSS UI Adds Inset Outline Offset
item.description:
CSS UI adds an inset value to outline-offset and improves the surrounding definition. The draft gives authors a way to place an outline inward rather than only offsetting it outside the border edge.

Changes: csswg-drafts 7fd9283d69; csswg-drafts d0c2a611d6.

item.title: WebDriver Fixes Keyboard and BiDi Serialization Details
item.description:
WebDriver corrects keyUp pressed-set handling. Related WebDriver BiDi fixes cover script value serialization, negative-zero rounding, locator node-count limits, unwrapping text and accessibility matches, and reading files before input.setFiles count checks.

Changes: webdriver-bidi cce53ea8cf; webdriver-bidi 085f76a831; webdriver-bidi 24ff1a2fca; webdriver-bidi 15442ce833; webdriver 7667c72e3b; webdriver-bidi 343534861d.

item.title: WCAG2ICT Refines Help, Timeouts and Focus Guidance
item.description:
WCAG2ICT updates explain context-sensitive help and preserving user data across inactivity in non-web software, with further work on focus-related criteria and closed-functionality cases. These are interpretive mappings, not new WCAG success criteria.

Changes: wcag2ict 6bb01bc9f8; wcag2ict 798adca81a; wcag2ict b9ec1e2a5d; wcag2ict 1d7a29dea5.

item.title: requestIdleCallback Defines a Zero Timeout Default
item.description:
The requestIdleCallback draft initializes the timeout member to zero and updates the algorithm to compare its value rather than testing for presence. This removes ambiguity in the default scheduling path.

Changes: requestidlecallback 90f50d38cd.

item.title: MathML Adds Multilingual Speech Examples for Intervals
item.description:
MathML draft examples now include language annotations and generated speech for half-open intervals in multiple languages. They illustrate how mathematical intent can support different spoken renderings.

Changes: mathml f5b270922a.

item.title: Reffy Improves Event Extraction
item.description:
The Reffy specification crawler now extracts composed values from event tables and uses clone-and-clean logic when parsing events, avoiding problems caused by generated definition panels and markup. This is tooling for standards data, not a normative API change.

Changes: reffy 3f94589846; reffy 9fae0207c8; reffy 900e4334cf.

item.title: RDF Test Manifests Refine Coverage and Requirements
item.description:
RDF test work adds top-level manifests for RDF and SPARQL suites, flags a federated SERVICE-variable test with its specific requirement, and removes disputed open-world date tests. These are conformance-test changes, not new syntax rules.

Changes: rdf-tests 7b5afb9185; rdf-tests 6ccccaabcc; rdf-tests cf14140e99.

item.title: SPARQL Service Description Clarifies Term Definitions
item.description:
The SPARQL Service Description draft adds term definitions and improves references for services and endpoints, including guidance for RDF serializations, RDFa embedding and content negotiation. It makes the service model easier to interpret.

Changes: sparql-service-description 2ae5e95332.

item.title: SHACL Rules Tightens Scope and Empty-Group Semantics
item.description:
The SHACL Rules draft disallows reuse of disconnected variable names across scopes and refines GROUP and aggregation tests. Bound grouping keys with no matches now demonstrate COUNT(*) of zero, helping pin down aggregate behavior.

Changes: data-shapes 04ecbb4a5b; data-shapes 3463560415; data-shapes ffe65d9b1d; data-shapes a7e58967d6.

item.title: Permissions Policy Standardizes Report Disposition Casing
item.description:
Permissions Policy now uses lowercase enforce and report dispositions when constructing policy reports. The change reduces inconsistencies in machine-readable reporting.

Changes: webappsec-permissions-policy ec5d32277a.

item.title: Web Locks Clarifies Aborts and Unavailable Requests
item.description:
Web Locks now propagates an AbortSignal's reason for a pending request, stops unavailable requests before enqueuing, ties queue processing to the request's agent, and clarifies rejection when a held lock is stolen.

Changes: web-locks 6dfe272f7b; web-locks 8d30e74283; web-locks 9aa6045f29; web-locks f8d59f6cb0.

item.title: CSS Overflow Refines Line-Clamp Grammar
item.description:
CSS Overflow adjusts line-clamp grammar for more flexible syntax and predictable serialization. It also clarifies that -webkit-line-clamp:none sets block-ellipsis to no-ellipsis, tightening legacy compatibility behavior.

Changes: csswg-drafts 64bbba2b5e; csswg-drafts 0396208d4a; csswg-drafts acde592534.

item.title: SPARQL Threat Model Begins as Draft
item.description:
A new SPARQL Threat Model document starts collecting security and privacy risks for current SPARQL Query specifications. Its own text describes it as a living draft, not a finalized W3C threat assessment.

Changes: sparql-threat-model 894ea930a2.

item.title: Recognized Entities Draft Defines Chain Validation
item.description:
The draft now specifies candidate-chain selection under a shared time budget, validates credentials from a recognition anchor down every link, and requires recognized actions to survive intermediate constraints. It adds typed credential validators, including JavaScript processing and resource-integrity guidance. This remains draft work.

Changes: vc-recognized-entities c13ef8a399; vc-recognized-entities 4677708cbf; vc-recognized-entities 0e2f9381d2; vc-recognized-entities 2c5f4eaa0c; vc-recognized-entities 36c6ec7ee7; vc-recognized-entities 57d0e382f2; vc-recognized-entities ac9af4c4cd; vc-recognized-entities 8afc543cf8; vc-recognized-entities f150cbcf01; vc-recognized-entities f07d6d09fc.

item.title: Embedded WebAuthn Request Explainer Expands Proposal
item.description:
The WebAuthn explainer now more clearly proposes authentication requests from applications embedding web content, such as in-app WebViews, on behalf of unrelated relying parties. This remains an explainer proposal, not a finalized authentication standard.

Changes: webauthn 4acf1a7c0a.

item.title: VCALM Draft Adds Exchange Termination and Credential Offers
item.description:
The VCALM draft adds an explicit done signal for ending an exchange, a credentialOffer parameter with grouping support, date-time format rules, and internationalization considerations. These are evolving credential-workflow definitions, not a finalized deployment profile.

Changes: vcalm 701791ae83; vcalm 8bb4207b32; vcalm 0ad2e624b5; vcalm b3f7050547; vcalm aad0ff93e1.

item.title: DID Resolution Test Suite Adds Method and Resolver Cases
item.description:
The DID Resolution test suite now defines resolver endpoints and method-specific test DIDs, using its own implementation and method definitions. This builds coverage for resolution interoperability rather than changing the protocol itself.

Changes: did-resolution-test-suite c3d1e1dba8; did-resolution-test-suite de6bcededa; did-resolution-test-suite 87fcee2e66.

item.title: W3C Process Revises Patent Obligations for Contributors
item.description:
W3C Process draft edits place responsibility on contributors to identify substantive contributions from parties outside existing patent-policy obligations when proposing class 3 or 4 changes. The revised language addresses how those obligations are obtained.

Changes: process 404e3d766a; process 2ca06ad178.

item.title: W3C Process Proposes Authorized Experiments
item.description:
A W3C Process proposal would let the Advisory Board authorize process experiments that temporarily modify or replace selected procedural rules. This is a proposal in the Process draft, not a blanket authorization for any group to disregard current rules.

Changes: process d9fd0c148e.

item.title: Bitstring Status List Clarifies Bit Order and Encoding
item.description:
The Verifiable Credentials Bitstring Status List draft specifies most-significant-bit ordering during bitstring generation and refines GZIP compression and encoding/expansion steps. These details matter to interoperable status-list implementations.

Changes: vc-bitstring-status-list 804d044420; vc-bitstring-status-list 98c19961d2.

item.title: EPUB Clarifies Date Formatting in Metadata and Certification
item.description:
EPUB drafts recommend ISO 8601-1 formatting for publication dc:date metadata and require it for a certifier report date. The distinction preserves a recommendation for general metadata while setting a firmer rule for certification reporting.

Changes: epub-specs cc99bd278b; epub-specs fbbd397200.

item.title: SHACL UI Adjusts Widget Selection and Ordering
item.description:
SHACL UI says renderers must not offer widgets they do not implement and must report when no matching supported widget exists. It also relaxes fallback ordering and tie-breaking from strict requirements to recommendations.

Changes: data-shapes 47c6e078bc; data-shapes dbf8b939c3.

item.title: Draft Publishing Charter Revises EPUB Deliverables
item.description:
The Publishing Maintenance Working Group charter draft revises EPUB 3.4 and 3.5 deliverables, considers Media Overlay updates including possible WebVTT support, and adds an EPUB Accessibility 1.2 explainer. These are proposed charter plans, not completed specification changes.

Changes: publ-maintenance-wg-charter d799a395dd; publ-maintenance-wg-charter a8b6579be0; publ-maintenance-wg-charter 800c1a302c; publ-maintenance-wg-charter 4a5d78f4c0.

item.title: Screen Wake Lock Drops Notification Recommendation
item.description:
The Screen Wake Lock draft removes a recommendation to show a notification while a lock is held. Its explanation notes that wake locks are released when a document loses visibility and implementations do not require an explicit grant to acquire one.

Changes: screen-wake-lock ede3fc0422.

item.title: Web Share Defines Both Presence-Flag Outcomes
item.description:
The Web Share specification explicitly sets its share-data presence flag to true when title, text or URL is supplied and false otherwise. This closes an algorithmic gap for empty share data.

Changes: web-share 938549365e.

item.title: SVG Draft Settles Attribute and Viewer Edge Cases
item.description:
SVG 2 clarifies that out-of-range attribute values fall back to initial values, deprecates SVG Tiny's focusable attribute, requires conforming viewers to support inline style, restricts svgView fragment whitespace, and defines which href attribute SVGAElement updates when both forms exist.

Changes: svgwg 742dd81bf7; svgwg 609c91693e; svgwg 251252de21; svgwg 0e46b8e3f7; svgwg d2abdfd9a4.

item.title: WebCodecs Clarifies Canceled Decodes and Frame Rectangles
item.description:
WebCodecs now ignores settlement tasks for canceled ImageDecoder promises and throws when a VideoFrame constructor receives an invalid visible rectangle. These changes tighten asynchronous and validation edge cases.

Changes: webcodecs fa8bfbb198; webcodecs 9bd52876e2.

item.title: Payment Method Registry Adds Secure Payment Confirmation
item.description:
The Payment Method Identifier specification lists secure-payment-confirmation among standardized payment method identifiers. This records the identifier in the registry; it does not by itself require merchants or browsers to support the method.

Changes: payment-method-id 3a123b9fb2.

item.title: RDF Validator Limits Resource Use to Avoid OOM
item.description:
The RDF validator service tightens process and memory limits for graph rendering to reduce out-of-memory failures. This is an operational hardening change to the tool, not a change to RDF validation semantics.

Changes: rdfvalidator-ng 7d32dbf807.

item.title: WoT Scripting Resolves Action Requests Against Thing Descriptions
item.description:
The Web of Things Scripting API draft looks up requested actions in the exposed Thing Description's actions map. The correction pins action handling to the described interface rather than an implicit or incorrect lookup.

Changes: wot-scripting-api 78afb03614.

item.title: CBOR-LD Refines Type-Scope Decoding
item.description:
The CBOR-LD draft reworks steps in its type-scope decoding algorithm, including how numeric term identifiers are read from input. This is algorithm clarification for compact linked-data decoding.

Changes: cbor-ld 6ee12ed442.

item.title: SHACL Rules Refines Aggregation and Grouping
item.description:
The SHACL Rules draft defines evalAggregate more precisely and treats an omitted BY clause as an implicit single group. It also refines aggregation assignment and well-formedness rules, making aggregate evaluation less ambiguous.

Changes: data-shapes e0aedcd5b0; data-shapes 3bb77ff31f; data-shapes 5a9bd002d0.

item.title: HTML Ruby Clarifies Assistive Reading Behavior
item.description:
The HTML Ruby draft clarifies that ruby text is made available to a speech user agent in document order, without forcing it onto users who configured a different reading behavior.

Changes: html-ruby 263a2e2a19.

item.title: Attribution Reporting Explains DAP Confidentiality Assumptions
item.description:
The Attribution Reporting draft adds detail about distributed aggregation using two independent operators, including its reliance on sound HPKE encryption for report confidentiality. This clarifies the trust model of a developing privacy mechanism.

Changes: attribution 1e63b8dc31.

item.title: Japanese Layout Draft Expands Ruby Guidance
item.description:
The Japanese layout draft expands its discussion of ruby placement, distinguishing per-character readings from readings that apply to a whole compound word, with examples. The work remains draft typography guidance.

Changes: jlreq-d 411dc38f30.

item.title: WebCodecs Tightens Frame Validation and Privacy Guidance
item.description:
WebCodecs checks VideoFrame buffer allocation against coded dimensions. Its expanded privacy considerations also discuss limiting supported configurations to a common baseline to reduce fingerprinting entropy.

Changes: webcodecs 0755634aa3; webcodecs 5762c7bc07.

item.title: CSS Mixins Refines Private Properties and Function Arguments
item.description:
CSS Mixins permits @property inside @private and clarifies empty arguments and trailing commas in @function calls. The related Properties and Values API draft adds a shorthand form for @property. These are draft syntax changes, not evidence of broad browser support.

Changes: css-houdini-drafts 27d37c60b5; csswg-drafts 909869d6b5; csswg-drafts 5df2d97275.

item.title: Audio Working Group Charter Advances to Proposed Status
item.description:
The Audio Working Group charter text changed to proposed status. It remains a proposed charter, and the status change should not be read as completion of its prospective speech or audio deliverables.

Changes: charter-drafts 28a94796b5.
